translation_snapshot.source:
When you are dealt a blow that reduces your life by at least %d%%, you have a %d%% chance to reduce the remaining cooldown of all your talents by 1.
		Temporary life from Sanguine Infusion will not count against the damage threshold.
		The chance will increase with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
当你受到的单次打击造成至少 %d%% 最大生命值的伤害时，每个冷却中的技能各有 %d%% 概率减少 1 回合冷却时间。
		鲜血灌注带来的额外生命值，不会影响该技能的伤害阈值。
		概率受法术强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source:
You strike the enemy with a rain of fast, acidic blows. You strike four times for pure acid damage. Every blow does %d%% damage.
		Every two talent levels, one of your strikes becomes blinding acid instead of normal acid, blinding the target 25%% of the time if it hits.
		Each point in acid drake talents also increases your acid resistance by 1%%.

		This talent will also attack with your shield, if you have one equipped.
translation_snapshot.target:
你以迅疾如雨的酸性打击攻击敌人，连续攻击四次，造成纯酸性伤害。每次攻击造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		每两个技能等级，其中一次攻击会由普通酸性伤害变为致盲酸性伤害；若命中，有 25%% 几率致盲目标。
		每投入一点毒龙系技能，酸性抗性提高 1%%。

		如果装备了盾牌，此技能也会使用盾牌攻击。

translation_snapshot.source: The target's mind has been shaken. It is temporarily aligned with %s and immune to all damage.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标的精神被支配，暂时处于 %s 阵营并免疫所有伤害。

translation_snapshot.source: Whether a pit-fighter, a boxer, or just an amateur practitioner, the Brawler's skills are still handy today.
translation_snapshot.target: 无论是一个职业拳手还是个业余的门外汉，格斗技能直到现在仍然十分有用。

translation_snapshot.source: A timeless elf stands before you. Even though his age is impossible to determine, you feel he has seen many things.
translation_snapshot.target: 一位中年精灵站在你面前，岁月不曾在其脸上留下痕迹。尽管你不知道他活了多久，但是你仍能感到他已经遍览世间万物。

translation_snapshot.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Daikara and vanquished the huge fire dragon that dwelled there.#WHITE#
translation_snapshot.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了岱卡拉并杀死了这里的火龙。#WHITE#
